units.title: Counting binary grids with prescribed odd row and column parity
units.statement: In an r×c binary grid, require every row and every column to have an odd number of marked cells. The row and column parity totals agree only when r and c have the same parity. In that case, the upper-left (r−1)×(c−1) cells are free; each remaining cell is determined uniquely by its row or column condition, giving 2^((r−1)(c−1)) grids. For a 21×21 grid the count is 2^400.
steps: Compare the parity of the total number of marked cells across rows and columns
Choose the upper-left block freely and fill the final row and column
Check the last corner condition is consistent when the dimensions have the same parity
